title: Academy promotion technical inputs and actual future receipt contracts
description: Top-level is frozen manifest. Separate $defs approval/evidenceIndex/processInputs/processReport/rootGate/acceptance/releaseCompleted describe actual separate inputs. Runtime checks custody/bytes/identity/freshness/effective configuration; no invented observation hashes or approval factory. PromotionInputs.v2 binds each runtime descriptor canonically to the common v3 execution manifest and exact reviewed baseline helper hash. Old v1 manifests and observer reports are rejected. Maintenance authority source-only binding: execution v5 requires pinned maintenance component and helper; promotion v4 and acceptance v3 reject old manifests. Actual observations/retained receipts and fresh current fences are required; no generated approval or placeholder runtime evidence. Sender census successor: execution v6, promotion v5, freeze v2 pins protected authority scope; v2 complete receipts require full current coverage, empty gaps, strict source bundles and genuine authority. Full eight-domain and remote adapters are presently unsupported and refuse; this schema creates no completed instance. Promotion v6 consumes the strict execution v7 manifest and current peer leaf verification; it grants no complete census or runtime authority.
